title: Chain Reaction
description: Tap the first domino and the rest of the row falls, so a child can see a chain reaction and predict that a longer row still starts with one tap.
learningObjectives: Predict that one tap can knock down a whole row of dominoes

params.description: How many dominoes stand in the row.

events.name: domino_toppled
events.description: The child tapped the first domino and the row began to fall.

events.name: chain_completed
events.description: The whole row finished falling after that one tap.

tutorGuide.intro: Tap the first domino and watch the row fall.
steps: Count the dominoes standing in the row.
Watch each one knock into the next.
observationPrompts: Did you need to tap every domino?
What happened to the last one?

misconceptions.belief: You have to tap every domino to knock them all down.
misconceptions.response: The first tap is enough. Each falling domino knocks into the next one.

hints: The domino that says Tap is the one you press.
One tap is enough for the whole row.
A longer row still starts with that same tap.

successCriteria.description: Tapped the first domino and the whole row fell

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: A row of dominoes. Tap the first one and the whole row falls.
